run_benchmark_plot_cli: run the benchmark plot script with --input and --output flags to generate a PNG from CSV results
run_plot_with_filter: run the benchmark plot script with --filter to exclude a specific function from the generated plot
plot_results_from_csv: plot benchmark results from a CSV file showing QPS vs thread count with 95% confidence intervals
plot_results_with_filter: plot benchmark results from CSV while filtering out a specific function name from the visualization
convert_bytes_to_human_readable: convert a byte size integer to a human-readable string like kB, MB, or GB
